notes: Warwick is one of the strongest level 1-3 melee duelists (Jaws of the Beast heal plus Eternal Hunger), and Infinite Duress at level 6 is a guaranteed suppress-and-kill tool, so early level leads and the level-6 gap weigh heavily. Ranged lanes deny that early window, and he falls off against tanks and scaling carries late, so the score is trimmed there; Blade of The Ruined King gives a short window where he shreds tanks. After laning he pressures a side lane and duels until about 28 minutes, then groups and flanks to Infinite Duress the enemy carry instead of splitting alone; when behind he groups rather than splitting.

motivation: Smell the blood. Every low target is yours.
Win the early game, and hunt from there. Good luck, have fun.
Short trades, big heals. Make them fight you where you're strongest.
Level 6 is the hunt. Save Infinite Duress for the kill, not the poke.
Blood Hunt shows you who's weak. Go get them.
Stay patient in the fog, then pounce. This one is yours.
